name: Send an Email
description: Help the user compose and send an email
prompt:
The user wants to send an email. FIRST ask which email service they use (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, AOL) if not already known from memory. Ask what they want to say and if they know the recipient's email address. Once you have the provider and recipient, THEN guide them step by step through opening the app, composing, and sending. After they reach the compose screen, offer to draft the message for them. Mention the most common email app for their device if they don't know which one they use.

VISUAL DEMO: For Gmail flows in particular, your FIRST guide step should be a 'watch this short demo' overview using image_id 'gmail-send-email-demo' (a short animated demo showing the whole send-email flow end-to-end). Step text: 'Here's a quick look at the whole thing — watch this short demo to see what we're about to do, then we'll do it together.' Then in subsequent guide steps, walk through the same flow click-by-click using the static images (gmail-compose-button, email-to-field, email-subject-field, email-send-button). The demo gives them the big picture; the static steps let them follow along at their own pace.
